The '''2019 Rosemount Championship''' (RMC) was held on 2 June 2019 at Rosemount Middle School in Rosemount, Minnesota, for current and former Rosemount players. [[Mark Walseth]] organized it. 14 players entered. [[Bryan Mischke]] won his second RMC title in a row, beating [[Charlie Arlandson]] in the final.<ref name="rmc19">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=72716 Rosemount Championship - 2019], forum.starwarsccg.org (21 May – 3 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004745/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t72716.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Rosemount Middle School, Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="rmc19" />
* '''Date:''' 2 June 2019<ref name="rmc19" />
* '''Structure:''' 5 games modified Swiss (SoS), then 2 rounds of modified match play for the top 4<ref name="rmc19" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="rmc19" />
* '''Field:''' 14 players<ref name="rmc19" />

In the semi-finals Bryan (TRM) played Sam (MAP) and Charlie (Diplo) played Brandon (Senate). In the final Bryan won game 1 by 20 and Charlie won game 2 by 15; Bryan was named champion. [[Logan Pietig]] was the highest-finishing first-year player.<ref name="rmc19" /> The full Swiss standings are in the photograph above.
